items.question: How many years is the public-private partnership term for the Warsan Waste-to-Energy Centre in Dubai?
items.fact: Warsan Waste-to-Energy Centre PPP runs 35 years under Dubai Municipality

items.question: How much electricity, in MW, does the Sharjah Waste to Energy plant generate for the Sharjah public grid?
items.fact: Sharjah Waste to Energy plant generates approximately 30 MW electricity
